sources.headline: Nick Sirianni on Jalen Hurts medical check: "Doctors have to do their job"
sources.description: Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts was visibly frustrated by a sideline concussion evaluation that kept him off the field for a promising drive that ended in an Andy Dalton interception during Monday night's game against the Bears.

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.headline: Jalen Hurts: I felt fine during concussion check, wish they could have expedited things
sources.description: Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts had to leave the game for a concussion evaluation after getting hit on the sideline during Monday night's loss to the Bears, and that proved costly for the Eagles: They were in the red zone at the time, but they came away with no points when backup quarterback Andy Dalton threw an interception.
